lane_top_down_model.note: ft = a * s + b with s rescaled so the ball at pin_hit reads 60 ft (a = a_fit / s_pin)

series_rule: jump rule: raw boards on frames >= cut pin_hit-2 are walked in order against the last kept raw board (seed = median of the 3 raw boards before); a frame more than 6.0 + 1.0 x (frames skipped) boards from it is dropped from boards and lane_top_down (kept in boards_raw); boards = 3-frame median of the cleaned raw; final_board = composition fit_path entry (Theil-Sen over cut pin_hit-10..pin_hit at cut pin_hit) on the cleaned series

events.exit_reason: last seen, ball hidden by pins after f373

how.pin_row_frame_est: first non-coasted ball frame >= release+8 whose centre y is at/above the headpin base row (midpoint of the pin column top and the edge pd row, 3-frame median), held on the next real frame with >= 3 real frames after it; fallback cuts.json pin_hit
how.entry_board: Theil-Sen over boards (3-frame median, cleaned) on pin_row-6..pin_row-1, evaluated at pin_row; entry_board_raw = cleaned raw board at pin_row
how.exit_frame: last non-coasted, moving (not deck_decoy) ball frame >= pin_row with a board; exit_board = boards there; exit_kind pit when the ball bottom is at/behind the back-row base row (headpin base moved 2.6 ft back through the edge vanishing point), else hidden; deck depth: frames pin_row..exit spread linearly from 60 ft to 62.6 (pit) or 61.3 (hidden)
how.deck_frames: non-coasted moving ball frames with a board from pin_row to exit
how.deflection: sign of exit_board - entry_board, dead band 2 boards (straight through inside it)
how.breakpoint_ft: ft_cv at the minimum of the 5-frame median of the cleaned raw boards over release..pin_row; breakpoint_at_roll_end = minimum in the first/last 2 roll frames (no measurable hook back)
how.ft_cv: 60 * (f - release) / (pin_row_frame_est - release); release is the cuts.json input
how.deck_decoy_from: first non-coasted ball point at/after pin_row-1 whose camera-compensated drift to every real point in the next 3 frames is < 3.0 px (a static purple patch in the pit/kickback, truth notes finding 5; threshold read off the drift table: moving >= 3.4, static <= 2.4); frames from it on do not count for exit, deck frames or the last real frame

final_board_rule: Theil-Sen over boards in pin_hit-10..pin_hit evaluated at pin_hit (composition fit_path), on the series after clean_series
